executive_summary: The company document chunks partially align with the NCA framework, but several violations and areas for improvement were identified, particularly in the implementation of stream ciphers, asymmetric key exchange, and hashing.
compliant_areas: Use of AES for symmetric encryption in the Moderate zone
Use of SHA-2 (SHA2-384) for digital signatures
Use of Elliptic Curve (ECC) based on NIST P-521 for key agreement in the Advanced zone
violations: Reuse of hardcoded Initialization Vector (IV) for stream ciphers in legacy IoT devices
Use of RSA with a 2048-bit key length, which does not meet the minimum requirement of 3072 bits for MODERATE
Use of SHA-2 (SHA2-512/256) in the Advanced zone, which is not accepted for ADVANCED
recommendations: Implement a secure random Initialization Vector (IV) for each stream cipher session
Upgrade RSA key length to at least 3072 bits for MODERATE and use a stronger algorithm like Elliptic Curve (ECC) for key exchange
Replace SHA-2 (SHA2-512/256) with SHA-3 (SHA3-512) in the Advanced zone for hashing and integrity
